answer: A tight ring of 151 clones therefore holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Because the zenith calculation reruns each epoch, the ripple weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the shale settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 53% independent neighbours on the funding graph. That is 4 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
